query: select u.id as "id!",u.email as "email!" from gateway_request_logs l join users u on u.id=l.user_id where l.organization_id=$1 and l.expires_at>now() and ($2::uuid is null or l.user_id=$2) and ($3::text is null or lower(u.email) like $3 escape E'\\') group by u.id,u.email order by (u.id=$4) desc,u.email limit 10
